shortcutsPage.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcutsPage.description: Speed up your workflow with these shortcuts.

closeConfirm.title: Close Salamander Browser?
closeConfirm.description: Would you like to send the app to the system tray or quit?

createProfile.title: Create your first profile
createProfile.content: Click here to create your first profile. Firefox — a fingerprint-protected browser — is used automatically.

dnsBlocking.title: DNS blocking
dnsBlocking.content: Use this dropdown to set a DNS blocklist level for the profile — it blocks ads, trackers, and malware at the network level. Higher levels block more.

thankYou.title: Thank you for choosing Salamander Browser
thankYou.body: Hopefully it helps make your browsing more private — every identity kept its own, and nothing leaving your machine. Enjoy.

welcome.title: Welcome to Salamander Browser
welcome.tagline: An open-source anti-detect browser for managing many identities at once.

permissions.title: Allow microphone & camera
permissions.desc: Grant access so sites that need a mic or camera work inside your browser profiles. macOS asks once; each site still asks you individually.

ready.title: Setting things up
ready.descDownloading: Downloading your first browser (Firefox). This one-time setup runs in the background — hang tight.
ready.descReady: Your browser is ready. Let's create your first profile.
ready.descExtracting: Extracting your browser. This one-time setup runs in the background — hang tight.
ready.errorDownload: {{browser}} couldn't be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
ready.errorExtraction: {{browser}} couldn't be extracted. Please try again.
ready.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while setting up {{browser}}. Please try again.

consistencyWarning.timezoneDetail: Exit node is in {{exit}} but the fingerprint reports {{fingerprint}}.
consistencyWarning.languageDetail: Exit country is {{country}} but the fingerprint language is {{fingerprint}}.
consistencyWarning.explainer: A timezone or language that disagrees with your exit IP is a strong anti-bot signal, even though your real device never leaks. Align the fingerprint with the proxy location to reduce hostile treatment.
consistencyWarning.matchSuccess: Fingerprint updated to match the proxy. Relaunch the profile to apply.

prelaunchGate.intro: Review these issues with "{{name}}" before starting the browser.
prelaunchGate.fingerprintHeading: The measured exit doesn't match the fingerprint
prelaunchGate.vpnExtensionIntro: Extensions in this profile that can reroute the browser's traffic:
prelaunchGate.vpnExtensionLikely: Looks like a VPN or proxy tool
prelaunchGate.vpnExtensionExplainer: If one of these routes your traffic elsewhere, the browser's real location will no longer match the timezone, language and geolocation this profile was created with, and Salamander cannot detect that from the outside.
prelaunchGate.proxyCapableHeading: Extensions that can change the proxy
prelaunchGate.proxyCapableIntro: These don't look like VPNs, but they hold Chromium's proxy permission, which download managers and debugging tools need too. Salamander cannot tell whether any of them is using it:
prelaunchGate.measurementUnreliable: An extension in this profile holds the proxy permission, so the exit check may not describe the route the browser actually takes.
prelaunchGate.scanIncompleteEncrypted: This profile is encrypted, so only Salamander-managed extensions could be checked.
prelaunchGate.scanIncompleteEphemeral: This profile has no data yet, so only Salamander-managed extensions could be checked.
prelaunchGate.scanIncompletePartial: The extension scan was cut short, so some extensions may not be listed.
prelaunchGate.probePending: The proxy exit hasn't been measured yet. Salamander will check it while starting and stop if it doesn't match.
prelaunchGate.dontBlockAgain: Don't block again for this exact mismatch
prelaunchGate.dontWarnExtensions: Don't warn again about these extensions
prelaunchGate.applyToRemaining: Apply this choice to the remaining profiles
prelaunchGate.scanIncompleteMissing: This profile has not been launched yet, so only Salamander-managed extensions could be checked.
